product_metadata.title: Stand Mixer, 7.5QT Kitchen Electric Food Mixer 10-Speed Tilt-Head Dough Mixer for Baking&Cake, with Stainless Steel Bowl, Whisk, Dough Hook, Beater, Splash Guard (660W) BLACK MC1

Our electric mixer for baking comes with a dough hook, flat beater, whisk, and Splash-proof cover to meet your different needs. All of the accessories are dishwashers available, you can just throw them in the dishwasher, feel free to clean quickly.

【Tilt-head & Anti-slip Design】 The tilt-head design mixer allows access to install or uninstall bowl and accessories easily. 6 Anti-slip silicone suction cups and solid connecting rod design can reduce vibration and noise, even will keep the machine steady in place while working.
